messages:
maggie: after the RBAC tidy this AM, SCIM started dropping some gov-admins members. Not all users, usually those with long attributes (fullname/email).

sam: any logs?

maggie: log snippet: 2025-06-01T09:12:34Z ERROR scim/provisioner PATCH /Groups/0xA returned 400 - 'members' truncated; assertion_size=12345 bytes.

jordan: sounds like SAML attr truncation. Did anyone change Okta group mapping or our serializer? KMS errors?

maggie: idp-bot: AssertionTooLarge at 09:12:33. KMS decrypts for signer OK.

izaac: audit entries show role assignments missing group attrs -> orphaned RBAC entries.

sam: temp fix: send group IDs instead of full names (shorter). Long fix: push group membership via SCIM or compress claims.

maggie: testing group-id mapping in staging with scim-patch --env=staging --file=patch-groups.json.

jordan: open vuln ticket to evaluate security impact of truncation on RBAC decisions.

maggie: opened SEC-2025-143, assigned sam (audit) and izaac (Okta mapping).

idp-bot: probe result: SAML assertion size=12512 bytes > configured_max=12288 -> rejected.

sam: Okta enforces ~12KB SAML attribute payload. Options: shrink SAML payload, use SCIM, or break into multiple assertions.

izaac: KMS note: decrypts fine but check JWE/envelope headers and cert chain; rotated cert could change encoding and size.

maggie: we rotated SAML cert last night at ~02:00. Rolled back to previous cert and retriggered staging SCIM resync; staging restored members.

sam: runbook we followed: 1) pause scim sync; 2) rollback cert; 3) trigger scim resync for group; 4) verify audit logs.

jordan: next steps: change Okta mapping to externalId/group-id, add SCIM-only fallback for groups over threshold, update incident runbook with cert rotation + KMS header checks, schedule coordinated cert rotations with Okta.

maggie: I'll draft postmortem and link SEC-2025-143 in internal docs, include timeline and mitigations.

sam: :thumbsup:

maggie: closing thread once postmortem reviewed.
